game.title: Assassin's Creed Rogue
game.blurb: Open-world action-adventure from Ubisoft (RAWG also lists Ubisoft Sofia and Ubisoft Kiev), published by Ubisoft Entertainment, released 2014-11-11. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Sequences 1 to 6, the final glitched memory, finishing the game and full synchronization in every main mission.

chapters.title: Present Day at Abstergo
chapters.summary: The Present 1 to 4 sections and repairing every computer in Abstergo Entertainment.

chapters.title: The Morrigan and the North Atlantic
chapters.summary: Upgrading the Morrigan, the Naval Campaign, legendary battles, convoys, icebergs and ice sheets, narwhals and reverse-boarding.

chapters.title: Forts, Gangs and Side Activities
chapters.summary: Forts, settlements, Gang HQs, supply camps, outposts, assassin interceptions, freeing prisoners of war, renovations and Abstergo Challenges.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Animus fragments, every location, Native hills and Ice Caves, the Native and Templar armour, and finishing every activity in one location.

chapters.title: Cheat Challenges
chapters.summary: Feats done with only the HUNTED, ENDURANCE or VETERANS cheat active.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Stalkers, smoke bombs, air surprise attacks and the berserk and sleep grenades.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry "assassins-creed-rogue-2" (id 17545); RAWG keeps "Assassin's Creed Rogue Remastered" separately, and the Steam store list has only app 311560, "Assassin's Creed® Rogue", which was used. StrategyWiki redirects "Assassin's Creed Rogue" to "Assassin's Creed: Rogue", a stub (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs): only the Table of Contents is written; Gameplay, Controls and Walkthrough are linked but not written. assassinscreed.fandom.com redirects the title to "Assassin's Creed: Rogue", with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 46 Steam achievements is hidden, and the sequences are named by number only. "Dedicated Employee" (35 Abstergo Challenges) was put with the side activities, not the present-day chapter, because the data does not say where those challenges are done. "Denied" (counter air surprise attacks) sits in combat as a guess.
